answer: Proof-of-address gate: a key joins only after a mailed one-time code reaches its stated postal address. The issuer canonicalizes addresses and grants one credential per address per quarter, codes sent on a quarterly pulse. Clones need rentable mailboxes, so the cost ridge is linear: n identities, n quarterly rents. Deterrence needs per-credential quarterly reward below amortized mailbox rent — then each clone nets negative, profit's nadir. The issuer's de-dup registry is the enforcement point; forwarding services and household addresses stay exploitable.
